de: Final stage of the Mexican War of Independence from Spain with Plan of Iguala.

t: 圭亚那德梅拉拉河畔由黄蜂号USS所着"孔雀号"(HMS Peacock)的"信".
te: Sinking of HMS Peacock by USS Hornet on the Demerara River, Guyana.
dz: 圭亚那德梅拉拉河畔由黄蜂号USS所着"孔雀号"(HMS Peacock)的"信".
de: Sinking of HMS Peacock by USS Hornet on the Demerara River, Guyana.

t: 拿破仑和普鲁士的弗雷德里克·威廉三世对俄罗斯的巴黎条约已经签订.
te: Treaty of Paris between Napoleon and Frederick William III of Prussia against Russia is signed.
dz: 拿破仑和普鲁士的弗雷德里克·威廉三世对俄罗斯的巴黎条约已经签订.
de: Treaty of Paris between Napoleon and Frederick William III of Prussia against Russia is signed.

t: 伦敦的德鲁里巷剧院被烧得一塌糊涂,使主人公,爱尔兰作家和政治家理查德·布林斯利·谢里丹一贫如洗.
te: London's Drury Lane Theatre burns to the ground, leaving its owner, Irish writer and politician Richard Brinsley Sherid…
dz: 伦敦的德鲁里巷剧院被烧得一塌糊涂,使主人公,爱尔兰作家和政治家理查德·布林斯利·谢里丹一贫如洗.
de: London's Drury Lane Theatre burns to the ground, leaving its owner, Irish writer and politician Richard Brinsley Sheridan, destitute.

t: 英国入侵并夺取了法国殖民地马提尼克.
te: Britain invades and captures the French colony of Martinique.
dz: 英国入侵并夺取了法国殖民地马提尼克.
de: Britain invades and captures the French colony of Martinique.

t: 在"马伯里诉麦迪逊案"中,美国最高法院确立了司法审查的原则.
te: In Marbury v. Madison, the Supreme Court of the United States establishes the principle of judicial review.
dz: 在"马伯里诉麦迪逊案"中,美国最高法院确立了司法审查的原则.
de: In Marbury v. Madison, the Supreme Court of the United States establishes the principle of judicial review.

t: 伊朗统治者纳德·沙阿的军队击败了印度莫卧儿皇帝穆罕默德·沙阿的军队.
te: The army of Iranian ruler Nader Shah defeats the forces of the Mughal emperor of India, Muhammad Shah.
dz: 卡纳尔战役:伊朗统治者纳德·沙阿的军队击败了印度莫卧儿皇帝穆罕默德·沙阿的军队.
de: Battle of Karnal: The army of Iranian ruler Nader Shah defeats the forces of the Mughal emperor of India, Muhammad Shah.

t: 由乔治·弗里德里克·汉德尔(英语:George Frideric Handel)所创作的里纳尔…
te: Rinaldo by George Frideric Handel, the first Italian opera written for the London stage, is premièred.
dz: 由乔治·弗里德里克·汉德尔(英语:George Frideric Handel)所创作的里纳尔多是第一部为伦敦舞台所创作的意大利歌剧,是预作.
de: Rinaldo by George Frideric Handel, the first Italian opera written for the London stage, is premièred.

t: L'Orfeo by Claudio Monteverdi, 第一部被公认为是一出歌剧的作品之…
te: L'Orfeo by Claudio Monteverdi, one of the first works recognized as an opera, receives its première performance.
dz: L'Orfeo by Claudio Monteverdi, 第一部被公认为是一出歌剧的作品之一,获得其预科表演.
de: L'Orfeo by Claudio Monteverdi, one of the first works recognized as an opera, receives its première performance.

t: 克吉战争的最后一场战役发生在奥斯特罗博特尼亚州伊尔马霍基的桑特武奥里山.
te: The last battle of the Cudgel War takes place on the Santavuori Hill in Ilmajoki, Ostrobothnia.
dz: 克吉战争的最后一场战役发生在奥斯特罗博特尼亚州伊尔马霍基的桑特武奥里山.
de: The last battle of the Cudgel War takes place on the Santavuori Hill in Ilmajoki, Ostrobothnia.

t: 教皇格列高利十三世在教皇敕令 Inter gravissimas 中宣布了公历。
te: With the papal bull Inter gravissimas, Pope Gregory XIII announces the Gregorian calendar.
dz: 教皇格列高利十三世在教皇敕令 Inter gravissimas 中宣布了公历。
de: With the papal bull Inter gravissimas, Pope Gregory XIII announces the Gregorian calendar.

t: 神圣罗马皇帝斐迪南一世与匈牙利和克罗地亚国王约翰·扎波利亚签订的"纳吉瓦拉德条约".
te: Treaty of Nagyvárad between Holy Roman Emperor Ferdinand I and King John Zápolya of Hungary and Croatia.
dz: 神圣罗马皇帝斐迪南一世与匈牙利和克罗地亚国王约翰·扎波利亚签订的"纳吉瓦拉德条约".
de: Treaty of Nagyvárad between Holy Roman Emperor Ferdinand I and King John Zápolya of Hungary and Croatia.

t: 将斐迪南一世加冕为布拉格的波希米亚国王.
te: Coronation of Ferdinand I as the king of Bohemia in Prague.
dz: 将斐迪南一世加冕为布拉格的波希米亚国王.
de: Coronation of Ferdinand I as the king of Bohemia in Prague.

t: 一支西班牙-奥地利军队在帕维亚战役中击败了一支法国军队.
te: A Spanish-Austrian army defeats a French army at the Battle of Pavia.
dz: 一支西班牙-奥地利军队在帕维亚战役中击败了一支法国军队.
de: A Spanish-Austrian army defeats a French army at the Battle of Pavia.

t: 那不勒斯和匈牙利国王查理三世被暗杀于布达.
te: King Charles III of Naples and Hungary is assassinated at Buda.
dz: 那不勒斯和匈牙利国王查理三世被暗杀于布达.
de: King Charles III of Naples and Hungary is assassinated at Buda.

t: 英国人在第一次苏格兰独立战争中被罗斯林战役所击败.
te: The English are defeated at the Battle of Roslin, in the First War of Scottish Independence.
dz: 英国人在第一次苏格兰独立战争中被罗斯林战役所击败.
de: The English are defeated at the Battle of Roslin, in the First War of Scottish Independence.

t: 万道尔人国王胡内里克用阿利安人取代了尼斯内主教,并驱逐了部分主教去科西嘉.
te: King Huneric of the Vandals replaces Nicene bishops with Arian ones, and banishes some to Corsica.
dz: 万道尔人国王胡内里克用阿利安人取代了尼斯内主教,并驱逐了部分主教去科西嘉.
de: King Huneric of the Vandals replaces Nicene bishops with Arian ones, and banishes some to Corsica.
